Gosh Authenticator for Linux - Installation Instructions
========================================================

Version: 1.2.0
Platform: Linux

DISTRIBUTION FORMATS
--------------------

1. Flatpak (recommended)
   - Sandboxed GTK 4 / Adwaita app: com.goshapps.YubicoAuthenticator
   - Works on any distro with Flatpak
   - Uses the host pcscd via --socket=pcsc

2. RPM Package
   - For Fedora, RHEL, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, openSUSE
   - Includes automatic desktop integration

3. DEB Package
   - For Debian, Ubuntu, and derivatives

4. Tarball
   - Portable binary for any Linux distribution
   - No package manager required

INSTALLATION METHODS
--------------------

### Flatpak

  flatpak install --user ./com.goshapps.YubicoAuthenticator.flatpak
  flatpak run com.goshapps.YubicoAuthenticator

  Or from this repository:

  ./build-flatpak.sh

### RPM

  sudo dnf install ./gosh-authenticator-1.2.0-1.fc43.x86_64.rpm

### DEB

  sudo apt install ./gosh-authenticator_1.2.0_amd64.deb

### Tarball

  tar -xzf gosh-authenticator-1.2.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
  cd gosh-authenticator-1.2.0-linux-x64
  ./gosh-authenticator

REQUIREMENTS
------------

- pcscd (PC/SC Smart Card Daemon)
- GTK 4
- libadwaita

To install pcscd:
  Fedora/RHEL: sudo dnf install pcsc-lite
  Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install pcscd
  Arch: sudo pacman -S pcsclite

Enable and start pcscd:
  sudo systemctl enable --now pcscd

USAGE
-----

1. Insert your YubiKey
2. Launch "Gosh Yubikey Manager" from your application menu
   or run: gosh-authenticator
3. Manage your OATH credentials
